messages.content: RAG is a framework that combines the generative capabilities of large language models with external knowledge retrieved from a separate database to enhance the accuracy and relevance of responses.

6ce0617cec82.title: what is the model used for virtual try-on?

messages.content: what is the model used for virtual try-on?
The model used for virtual try-on is the pre-trained LaDI-VTON model with Dress Code weights.
